title: R4 core business hidden and partial flows
businessRules: Supplier master lifecycle is tenant scoped; inactive suppliers cannot be selected for new purchase documents while historical transactions remain readable.
Inventory quantity remains authoritative only through append-only InventoryMovement; R4 only exposes the canonical ledger and does not mutate balances from UI.
Goods receipt rejection must occur before posting and must not create stock or journal entries.
AccountingCloseControl CLOSED blocks accounting-core posting for the controlled branch/company period until an explicit audited reopen.
General Ledger UI reads the existing POSTED journal report and does not recompute accounting truth client-side.
Storefront branch is runtime-selectable within the same company; environment branch is bootstrap fallback only.
Advanced promotions remain server authoritative and operator lifecycle cannot bypass checkout validation.
R4 tidak mengubah tax core: tax code version/effective period yang berlaku tetap menjadi satu-satunya authority untuk pajak pada posting.
acceptanceCriteria: F30 AccountingCloseControl has API/operator lifecycle and accounting-core posting enforcement.
F34 canonical inventory movement ledger is visible to operators.
F35 goods receipt reject is exposed in Admin and preserves pre-posting fail-close.
F36 supplier master supports detail/update/activate/deactivate and inactive supplier is rejected for new procurement.
F38 General Ledger report is callable from Admin UI.
F40 Storefront can switch active branches at runtime without source/env rebuild.
F41 advanced promotion types have operator lifecycle controls while server validation remains authoritative.
SQLite/PostgreSQL Supplier schema parity remains exact and schema change is expand-only.
testPlan: Inventory invariant: no R4 UI endpoint mutates inventory balance except existing domain services that append InventoryMovement.
Accounting invariant: CLOSED AccountingCloseControl rejects posting and reopen requires audited reason.
Tenant/permission regression for supplier, close control, goods receipt rejection and report access.
GitHub six-app build and existing Built Browser UAT remain required before R4 CLOSED.
Accounting invariant: setiap posting jurnal yang berhasil tetap debit = credit; close-control hanya memblok posting dan tidak membuat jurnal alternatif.
migrationPlan: Expand-only Supplier.isActive Boolean default true is added identically to SQLite and PostgreSQL schemas. Existing suppliers remain active. No destructive migration, reset, or data rewrite.
rollbackPlan: Revert R4 source/UI and leave Supplier.isActive column in place as a backward-compatible expand-only field. Reopen any test close control before rollback; never delete historical InventoryMovement or accounting records.
monitoringPlan: Audit supplier updates, goods-receipt rejection, accounting close/reopen actions, and GitHub build/browser evidence. Existing accounting/inventory integrity gates remain authoritative.
securityNotes: Tenant scope comes from authenticated identity. Public storefront branch discovery is anchored by an existing active branch code and only returns active sibling branches of that company.
releaseEvidence: ci:r4:probe PASS on exact PostgreSQL runtime for supplier lifecycle, receipt rejection/no movement, inventory ledger, close/reopen, General Ledger, storefront branch discovery, and advanced promotion lifecycle
Human Stage-20 remains PENDING and separate
